nodes.description: AddressBook contract address that records the Whitelist module and Otoken implementation addresses; set in constructor and read for every external module lookup.
Public dynamic array holding every oToken address created by the factory; pushed to on each successful creation.
Private mapping from the keccak256 option parameter hash to the deployed oToken address; used for duplicate detection and lookups.
Private constant upper bound on expiry (2345/12/31 = 11865398400) used to bound the BokkyPooBahsDateTimeLibrary.
Private constant bytes32(0) salt used for every CREATE2 deployment in OtokenSpawner.
Constructor that stores the AddressBook address passed as _addressBook into the addressBook state variable.
External entry point that validates expiry/product parameters, hashes the option id, spawns an eip-1167 minimal proxy via CREATE2 and whitelists the new oToken.
External entry point that mirrors createOtoken but additionally requires msg.sender to be a whitelisted owner and initializes the oToken as whitelisted.
View function returning the length of the otokens array.
View function returning the deployed address of a non-whitelisted oToken for a given parameter set.
View function returning the deployed address of a whitelisted oToken for a given parameter set.
View function computing the deterministic CREATE2 address an oToken with the given parameters would be deployed at.
Internal pure function hashing all option parameters with keccak256/abi.encodePacked to produce the unique option id.
Internal function that builds the Spawn creation code and deploys an eip-1167 minimal proxy via Create2.deploy.
Internal view function that hashes the Spawn init code and returns the CREATE2 target address via Create2.computeAddress.
Library function that performs the low-level CREATE2 deployment, requiring sufficient balance and non-zero bytecode.
Spawn constructor that delegatecalls the logic contract with the supplied initialization calldata and returns eip-1167 runtime code.
Caller-controlled address used as the option creator in the OtokenCreated event and for the whitelisted-owner check.
The now keyword used for expiry validation (expiry > now), making option creation timestamp dependent.
Inline assembly CREATE2 opcode that deploys arbitrary bytecode at a deterministic address using a fixed salt.
delegatecall inside Spawn.constructor that executes the logic contract initialization code in the proxy's context during deployment.
External calls to AddressBookInterface(addressBook).getWhitelist() and getOtokenImpl() returning module addresses that are trusted blindly.
External call WhitelistInterface(whitelist).whitelistOtoken(newOtoken) executed after state updates, an reentrancy-capable external interaction.
SafeMath subtraction and modulo on _expiry (_expiry.sub(28800).mod(86400)) enforcing 08:00 UTC expiry alignment.
External calls to isWhitelistedProduct, isWhitelistedOwner and constructor checks on the Whitelist module used as access-control gates.
Underlying asset address parameter of createOtoken, hashed into the option id and passed to init.
Strike asset address parameter of createOtoken, hashed into the option id and passed to init.
Collateral asset address parameter of createOtoken, hashed into the option id and passed to init.
Strike price parameter of createOtoken (18 decimals), hashed into the option id and validated against zero for puts.
Expiry timestamp parameter of createOtoken, validated against now, MAX_EXPIRY and the 08:00 UTC rule.
Boolean parameter of createOtoken selecting put vs call, used in id hashing and the zero-strike check.
Local bytes32 option id computed by _getOptionId inside createOtoken and used as the idToAddress mapping key.
Local address of the whitelist module fetched from the AddressBook inside createOtoken.
Local bytes payload built with abi.encodeWithSelector for the oToken init function inside createOtoken.
Local address of the newly spawned oToken returned by _spawn inside createOtoken, then stored and emitted.
Underlying asset address parameter of createWhitelistedOtoken, hashed into the option id and passed to init.
Expiry timestamp parameter of createWhitelistedOtoken, validated against now, MAX_EXPIRY and the 08:00 UTC rule.
Local bytes32 option id computed by _getOptionId inside createWhitelistedOtoken with the whitelisted flag set to true.
Local address of the newly spawned whitelisted oToken returned by _spawn inside createWhitelistedOtoken.
Local address of the oToken implementation logic contract retrieved from the AddressBook in getTargetOtokenAddress.
Local bytes init code combining the Spawn creation code with the ABI-encoded logic contract and initialization calldata.
Bytes parameter carrying the initialization calldata delegatecalled by the spawned Spawn contract.

edges.reason: msg.sender is emitted as the option creator in createOtoken and controls who triggers option creation.
block.timestamp (now) gates createOtoken via require(_expiry > now), making creation timestamp dependent.
msg.sender is passed to isWhitelistedOwner as the authorization check in createWhitelistedOtoken.
block.timestamp (now) gates createWhitelistedOtoken through the same expiry validation.
createOtoken calls _getOptionId to derive the unique option id.
createWhitelistedOtoken calls _getOptionId with the whitelisted flag set to true.
createOtoken calls _spawn to deploy the eip-1167 minimal proxy for the new oToken.
createWhitelistedOtoken calls _spawn to deploy the whitelisted oToken proxy.
_spawn delegates the actual deployment to Create2.deploy with amount 0 and the fixed SALT.
Create2.deploy executes the inline assembly create2 opcode to deploy the bytecode.
The spawned Spawn contract's constructor executes during creation and runs the init callback into the logic contract.
Spawn.constructor performs a delegatecall into the logic contract with the factory-supplied initialization calldata, giving it control during deployment.
createOtoken queries the AddressBook for the whitelist module address and the oToken implementation address.
createOtoken relies on Whitelist.isWhitelistedProduct as the product access-control gate.
createOtoken performs an external call to whitelistOtoken after updating idToAddress and otokens, enabling reentrancy into the factory.
createOtoken uses SafeMath sub and mod on _expiry to enforce 08:00 UTC expiry alignment.
createWhitelistedOtoken uses the same SafeMath sub and mod arithmetic on _expiry.
createOtoken reads the addressBook state variable to resolve the whitelist and oToken implementation.
createOtoken writes the deployed address into the idToAddress mapping.
createOtoken pushes the newly created oToken into the otokens array.
createWhitelistedOtoken writes the deployed address into the idToAddress mapping.
createWhitelistedOtoken pushes the newly created oToken into the otokens array.
The _expiry parameter of createOtoken flows into the sub/mod arithmetic validation.
The _expiry parameter of createWhitelistedOtoken flows into the sub/mod arithmetic validation.
_underlyingAsset parameter is consumed by createOtoken for id hashing, whitelist checks and init calldata.
_expiry parameter is consumed by createOtoken for validation, id hashing and init calldata.
_underlyingAsset parameter is consumed by createWhitelistedOtoken for id hashing, whitelist checks and init calldata.
_expiry parameter is consumed by createWhitelistedOtoken for validation, id hashing and init calldata.
getTargetOtokenAddress calls _computeAddress to derive the deterministic CREATE2 target address.
getOtoken calls _getOptionId to derive the lookup key for the non-whitelisted variant.
getWhitelistedOtoken calls _getOptionId to derive the lookup key for the whitelisted variant.
The bytes32 returned by _getOptionId is captured in the local id variable of createOtoken.
The local id variable is used as the idToAddress mapping key in createOtoken.
The address returned by _spawn is captured in the local newOtoken variable.
The local whitelist module address is the target of the whitelistOtoken external call.
The locally fetched otokenImpl address is used to build the init selector and compute the target address.
The locally built initCode is the bytecode passed to Create2.deploy inside _spawn.
The initializationCalldata parameter is ABI-encoded into the init code used by _spawn.

normalization_plan.reason: _underlyingAsset is a createOtoken parameter whose only purpose is to feed the createOtoken core function.
_strikeAsset is a createOtoken parameter that flows directly into the createOtoken core function.
_collateralAsset is a createOtoken parameter that flows directly into the createOtoken core function.
_strikePrice is a createOtoken parameter consumed only by the createOtoken core function.
_expiry is a createOtoken parameter used for validation, hashing and init calldata inside createOtoken.
_isPut is a createOtoken parameter consumed only by the createOtoken core function.
The local id alias is fully determined inside createOtoken and should be folded into it.
The local whitelist address is derived and consumed entirely within createOtoken.
The local initializationCalldata buffer is built and used only inside createOtoken.
The local newOtoken return alias is produced and returned only inside createOtoken.
_underlyingAsset is a createWhitelistedOtoken parameter that flows only into that core function.
_expiry is a createWhitelistedOtoken parameter used for validation, hashing and init calldata in that core function.
The local id alias is computed and consumed entirely inside createWhitelistedOtoken.
The local newOtoken return alias is produced and returned only inside createWhitelistedOtoken.
The local otokenImpl address is fetched and used only inside getTargetOtokenAddress.
The local initCode buffer is built and passed directly to Create2.deploy inside _spawn.
The initializationCalldata parameter of _spawn exists solely to build the init code inside _spawn.
